frozen_forecast.expected_path: Uneven, choppy action is more defensible than a one-way market call. BTC may remain relatively firmer or attempt a modest extension, while ETH and most alt proxies lag or retest. Snapshot spot support does not establish sustained BTC continuation, and BTC resilience does not establish alt transmission.
falsification_conditions: Persistent BTC strength across fresh completed candles, accompanied by strengthening ETH/BTC and broadly positive alt medians and participation, would invalidate the selective, mixed outlook toward UP.
Sustained BTC weakness together with continued ETH/BTC declines and widening weakness across capitalization proxies would invalidate the outlook toward DOWN.
A fresh sequence showing synchronized, low-directional-movement consolidation without the current BTC/alt divergence would favor SIDEWAYS instead.
